name: desktop-project-isolation
goal: Explicit project requests cannot cross repositories; comments never start agents and disposable caches bind notes and evidence revisions

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Explicit project requests must reject stale selection; human comments are private pending drafts without agent/source mutations; shared writes need verified server acknowledgments and cache identity includes independent notes/evidence.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Before implementation remote-http-project.test.ts failed3/3 missing addComment and origin rejection; native-session.test.ts failed1/1 missing encrypted save; direct Bun baseline registry/cache API checks failed before local implementation.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Implemented optional scoped bridge, private project registry/outbox, verified disposable image cache, HTTPS shared transport, remote no-agent routing, PKCE polling and safeStorage session persistence; preserved legacy no-project calls.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: 22 new nonvisual assertions cases pass; full desktop suite70/70 passes including unchanged cancellation outcomes after deterministic runner-entry wait; typecheck/lint/owned format/main build pass. UI/native final integration remains pending.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Full desktop check and 23 browser cases pass. Native Electron automated; manual Mac QA blocked by locked screen.
